opening.quote: Good afternoon, thank you for calling Tidewell Home, Bram speaking. How can I help you?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Done, I've updated the account to eva.smit@example.com. Your next order confirmation will go there.
verification.comment: You changed account data without first confirming the caller's full name plus an order number or account postcode; always verify identity before making changes or sharing order details.

understanding.quote: I'd like to change the email address on my account, I don't use the old one any more.
understanding.comment: You captured the caller's request to change the email address and asked only for the new address, which was needed.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Yes, your lamp shipped this morning and arrives in 2 to 4 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The delivery window of 2 to 4 working days matches standard delivery policy, and the shipping statement was not contradicted by anything in the call.

process_compliance.quote: Done, I've updated the account to eva.smit@example.com.
process_compliance.comment: No hold, damage, chargeback or goodwill step applied to this call, so the process requirements are met.

communication.comment: The caller showed no frustration, but your reply was curt; a warmer tone such as 'Is there anything else I can help with?' would have been more polite.

closing.comment: You did not confirm next steps or ask if there was anything else, and the call ended abruptly; close by confirming the email change and asking if the caller needs anything else.
